evals.prompt: Plan the opening for a 35-second vertical news reel for ordinary viewers. A new report says California lawmakers may stop sales of new gas lawnmowers next year if manufacturers do not meet tougher noise and pollution rules. The source headline is "California legislature weighs conditional small-engine phaseout under emissions compliance framework." Give me an opening that beats that headline without overstating an unsigned proposal.
evals.expected_output: Runs the hook lab before scripting: ten or more materially different candidates across six or more lenses (at most two per lens), jargon and blocked money verbs only as rejected lines, three or more finalists compared with the source title, one display hook of at most eight words bound to the first three seconds, and uncertainty preserved.
assertions: Generates at least ten materially distinct hook candidates spanning at least six causal lenses, with no more than two from one lens

The displayed candidate set contains no unexplained policy jargon such as legislature, conditional, phaseout, emissions compliance, or framework; weak or blocked lines appear only as rejected lines with reasons
Compares at least three finalists against the source title for immediate meaning, curiosity, accuracy, one-breath delivery, and drawable first frame
Selects one display hook of eight words or fewer with one recognizable actor, one concrete action, and one consequence, and records why the other finalists lost
Maps the winner to exact first-three-second on-screen copy, voiceover, visual action, and a compact evidence qualifier
Does not claim the proposal passed, that mower sales already stopped, or that the date is settled

Searches before generating along reuse, source, inspired_generation, original_generation, with discovery results limited to selected_source, inspiration_for_generation, or searched_no_reference
Rejects custom-created SVG animation assets and SVG or JSX scene substitutes
Names concrete expected output file paths and treats a prompt or provider job as not yet an accepted file
Keeps the HyperFrames handoff blocked until required visuals have accepted files and does not render
